title: Ranked Object Extraction
written_solution: The top-left cell gives a rank: 1 largest, 2 second largest, 3 third largest. Rank the disconnected objects by area and crop out the object at that rank.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let* ((rank (at g 0 0))
         (clean (set-cell g 0 0 0))
         (objs (sort (objects clean 0)
                     (lambda (a b)
                       (cond [(not (= (obj-size a) (obj-size b))) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b))]
                             [(not (= (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))) (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))]
                             [else (< (obj-color a) (obj-color b))]))))
         (obj (list-ref objs (- rank 1))))
    (subgrid clean (obj-r1 obj) (obj-c1 obj) (obj-r2 obj) (obj-c2 obj))))
